referenceFunction.generalComment: The shares are based on the current core management of French PWRs, at equilibrium, where 20 units of the 900 MW class use 30% MOX. Not all plutonium extracted at reprocessing from French spent fuel elements seems to be used at present, but in the near future this will be achieved with other units operating with MOX. Hence, the indication of data validity inputted in "TimePeriod" only says that the shares represent the knowledge available today of the fuel management for the French nuclear park.; UUID: 243d243a-10be-319b-97a7-65f725b59892
